preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 2 and 3000.
The number of edges m must be at least 1 and at most the maximum number of edges in a complete graph.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and 0 <= w <= 100000 for u, v, w in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect valid nodes and have a non-negative weight.
The starting node must be a valid node index.

postconditions.description: The output must be the total weight of the minimum spanning tree as a string.
